data.reasoning: The package is a standard GNU release downloading from the official GNU FTP server with PGP signature verification. The apparent disagreement was solely caused by a transient API error (HTTP 400) in the Qwen model during the full file review, which carries no verdict signal. The valid report from Deepseek correctly identified the PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO as safe, with standard build steps and no malicious injections.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was triggered by a tool error in the Qwen model (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) during the second-pass review of the PKGBUILD, forcing an 'inconclusive' result. The other models successfully completed their reviews and found no issues.
coverage_issues: Qwen model experienced an API failure (HTTP 400) during the full PKGBUILD review, resulting in a missing verdict for that pass.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback routing for transient API errors (like HTTP 400) to prevent unnecessary inconclusive verdicts, especially when the initial sourcing gate has already passed safely.
